## Description

Brief summary of the changes introduced in this PR.

## Type of Change

- [ ] `feat`: New feature / contract entrypoint / UI addition
- [ ] `fix`: Bug fix
- [ ] `test`: New test cases or coverage improvements
- [ ] `docs`: Documentation updates
- [ ] `refactor`: Code restructuring with no behavior change

## Verification Checklist

- [ ] Smart contract tests pass (`cargo test` in `agriresolve-contract`)
- [ ] Contract builds optimized wasm (`stellar contract build`)
- [ ] Web application builds cleanly (`pnpm build` in `agriresolve-app/apps/web`)
- [ ] Code is formatted (`cargo fmt` and linter checks)
